metric_protocol.N01_supplemental_macro: STRICT_FINAL_LABEL only: unweighted mean over all 37 frozen global source classes, including zero-support classes, zero_division=0. Invalid/missing predictions are a separate sentinel: incorrect for accuracy and false-negative for their gold class. Not an exact reconstruction of the unavailable paper macro scorer.
metric_protocol.STRICT_FINAL_LABEL: Use message.content only. Take suffix after last case-insensitive Answer: marker when present. Remove source punctuation, collapse whitespace, match exactly one fixed vocabulary label. For VEP only, permit a semicolon disease suffix; reject both benign/pathogenic word labels anywhere in final content. No synonyms, gold-assisted extraction, reasoning fallback or model judge.
metric_protocol.continuation_reconstruction: Saved message.reasoning (or unambiguous legacy reasoning_content), one newline separator if nonempty, then exact saved message.content. Never append the prompt, reference, a generated Answer: marker or an inferred class.
metric_protocol.decoder_qualification: Source dependencies are unpinned; local chat archives lack original generated token IDs and parser-removed boundary markers. Source rules are reproduced on saved fields, not asserted byte-identical to author decoding. Reasoning-parser identity/raw-boundary equivalence remains qualified.
metric_protocol.native_N01: Continuation only; extract text after the last case-sensitive literal Answer:, strip/lower, remove . , ! ? double/single quotes from prediction and gold, then test gold substring membership.
metric_protocol.native_N02_N03: Continuation only, including generated reasoning: normalized source gold class as a case-insensitive substring anywhere. Source TP/FN for pathogenic; TN/FP for benign according to whether its own gold substring occurs.
metric_protocol.planned_denominator: Every frozen planned case remains in accuracy denominator. Missing/failed outputs are incorrect; no filtering, fabricated label, retry or completion selection. F1 uses declared confusion counts; no valid-only subset.
metric_protocol.primary_metrics: N01 accuracy; N02/N03 accuracy and pathogenic-positive f1. Never replace with a better-looking diagnostic.
metric_protocol.prompt_exclusion: BioReason DNALLMModel.generate passes inputs_embeds without input_ids to decoder-only HF generate; the supported Transformers path initializes returned token IDs with length zero. Its vLLM implementation returns out.outputs[0].text. Both are generated continuation paths, not prompt+continuation.
